{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes

# Check unique values in 'status' column
status_unique = sales_df['status'].unique()

# Check for duplicate rows
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

missing_values, dtypes, status_unique, duplicates"}
